title.en: Bug hunt: who takes my points?
title.sk: Hľadanie chyby: kto mi berie body?

en: A bug hunt: two handlers fight over the score.
Play, grab a banana and watch ⭐: does the score grow?
Open “Which handler fired?”: which handler changes ⭐ on every tick?
sk: Hľadanie chyby: dve obsluhy sa bijú o skóre.
Hraj, chyť banán a sleduj ⭐: rastie skóre?
Otvor „Ktorá obsluha sa spustila?“: ktorá mení ⭐ v každom ťahu?

goal.en: `on_item` adds a point, but `on_tick` sets the score back to 0 on every tick. Take `score.set(0)` out of `on_tick`.
goal.sk: `on_item` pridá bod, ale `on_tick` v každom ťahu vráti skóre na 0. Vyber `score.set(0)` z `on_tick`.

goal.en: Two handlers may both change the score if they add, not reset: in `on_tick` give a bonus point every 50 ticks with `ticks()`.
goal.sk: Dve obsluhy môžu meniť skóre obe, ak pridávajú, nie nulujú: v `on_tick` daj bonusový bod každých 50 ťahov pomocou `ticks()`.

goal.en: In `on_item`, call `win()` once the score reaches 6.
Make `class Guard(Critter):` that walks, and in `on_touch(critter)` take one point with `score.add(-1)`: a fair way to lose points.
goal.sk: Urob `class Guard(Critter):`, ktorý chodí, a v `on_touch(critter)` uber jeden bod pomocou `score.add(-1)`: férový spôsob, ako body strácať.

goal.en: Pick a twist card and add it to your game. Then press "Test my game".
goal.sk: Vyber si kartu s nápadom a pridaj ho do hry. Potom stlač „Otestuj moju hru“.
